import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { suppliers } from "../../../backend/schema/suppliers";

export const suppliersCms = customizeTable<typeof suppliers>("suppliers", {
    display: {
        title: "companyName"
    },
    listFields: ["supplierId", "companyName", "contactName", "contactTitle", "phone", "address"],
    fields: {
        homepage: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "supplierId",
        "companyName",
        "contactName",
        "contactTitle",
        "phone",
        "address",
        "city",
        "region",
        "postalCode",
        "country",
        "fax",
        "homepage"
    ]
});
